title: Production backend contract and catalogue security verification
summary: The privileged aggregate verifier passed every database, privacy, catalogue, pricing, image, audit, realtime, and least-privilege invariant, and the complete Node and pinned Python dependency audits reported no known vulnerabilities.

checks.name: Backend contract version
checks.detail: The expected and observed production backend contract versions both equal 2026-07-16.7.

checks.name: Catalogue governance
checks.detail: The verifier found 2200 approved live consumer products, 25 taxonomy pairs, and no approval or rejection audit gaps.

checks.name: Central pricing boundary
checks.detail: The verifier found no Amazon-derived prices, no current pharmacy-specific catalogue prices, and no public stock support.

checks.name: Least-privilege boundary
checks.detail: Every expected protected table and function boundary passed without unexpected anonymous or authenticated access.

checks.name: Node dependency vulnerability audit
checks.detail: The complete production and development dependency tree reported zero known vulnerabilities after replacing the vulnerable development-only esbuild dependency.

checks.name: Python dependency vulnerability audit
checks.detail: All nine exactly pinned scraper and product-image dependencies reported zero known vulnerabilities in OSV; secure Python 3.11 wheels were also verified available.

checks.name: Integrated automated regression suite
checks.detail: The release gate completed 151 Node tests and 32 Python pipeline tests with zero failures.
